message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or a holiday that creates a three‑day stretch when combined with a weekend). For each holiday I’ve noted the day of the week it fell on and the resulting long‑weekend span.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-----|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 18–20** (Fri‑Sat‑Mon) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | **May 20–22** (Fri‑Sat‑Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2–4** (Fri‑Sat‑Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7–9** (Fri‑Sat‑Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 | Monday | **Nov 9–11** (Fri‑Sat‑Mon) |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23–25** (Fri‑Sat‑Mon) |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 | Tuesday | **Dec 24–26** (Sat‑Sun‑Tue) – *Note*: This creates a 4‑day stretch (Sat‑Sun‑Mon‑Tue) but only the first three days are a traditional long weekend. |

### Quick Summary

- **January**: New Year’s Day (Sunday) → 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon)
- **February**: Family Day (Monday) → 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon)
- **April**: Good Friday (Friday) → 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun)
- **May**: Victoria Day (Monday) → 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon)
- **July**: Canada Day (Saturday) → 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon)
- **September**: Labour Day (Monday) → 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon)
- **October**: Thanksgiving (Monday) → 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon)
- **November**: Remembrance Day (Monday) → 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon)
- **December**: Christmas Day (Monday) → 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Mon); Boxing Day (Tuesday) adds an extra day but isn’t part of the traditional long weekend.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like it formatted differently!
